parameters.name: DefaultVersionNumber
parameters.description: The version number of the launch template to be set as the default version.

parameters.name: LaunchTemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the launch template. You must specify LaunchTemplateId or LaunchTemplateName to determine the template.

parameters.name: LaunchTemplateName
parameters.description: The name of the launch template. You must specify LaunchTemplateId or LaunchTemplateName to determine the template.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the launch template. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
